title: Simple Essentials
description: A Plugin that adds some simple and cool features to your Minecraft Server
body:
# SimpleEssentials – The Ultimate Lightweight Essentials & Moderation Plugin

SimpleEssentials is a fast, modular, highly customizable essentials plugin designed for servers that wan't powerful utility, moderation, and QoL commands without the bloated overhead of other essentials plugins.

It provides clean configuration files, intuitive commands, advanced serverlist customization, multi-homes, warp systems, vanish, moderation, GUIs, and optional fake player counts. Everything is done trough a permission system and permissions can be given to any player.

Perfect for:
- Survival & SMP
- RPG
- Minigames
- Community servers
- Admin & staff-managed servers

## ✨ Features
**🔹 Customizable Server List (MOTD, Fake Player Count, Dynamic Refresh)**

Control exactly how your server appears in the multiplayer list:

**MOTD (2 lines):**

```
line1: "&6Welcome to our Server!"
line2: "&7A Minecraft Server"
```

**Max Players Displayed:**

Set a custom capacity (visual only).

**Fake Player Count:**
- static mode (always show a fixed number)
- range mode (random between min/max)
- optional automatic refresh every X ticks

Perfect for community servers that want to show activity levels without affecting real players.

**🔹 Powerful GameMode, Fly, Heal & Godmode Tools**

Essential admin commands with clean messages:
- /gamemode survival | creative | adventure | spectator
- /fly
- /heal
- /godmode

Includes:
- self or other player support
- detailed feedback messages
- invalid input protection

**🔹 Complete Vanish System (with Auto-Vanish)**

Stay invisible to players & mobs.
- /vanish
- /autovanish

Features:
- auto-vanish on join
- vanish on login
- visibility protection
- permission-based access

Great for staff and moderators.

**🔹 Warp System with Permissions & Validation**

Create unlimited warps with:
- custom names
- validation rules (no spaces, max length, no illegal chars)
- creator tracking
- world validation
- full list command with formatted output

Commands:
- /setwarp <name>
- /warp <name>
- /delwarp <name>
- /warps

**🔹 Homes System (Multi-Home, Limits, Lists, Teleport)**

Players can set multiple homes with limits:

```
homes:
  default_limit: 5
```

Includes:
- /sethome <name>
- /home <name>
- /delhome <name>
- /homes

Each home stores:
- coordinates
- world
- creation date

Clean list formatting & click-to-teleport support.

**🔹 Server Spawn System & Join Teleport**

Admins can set a global spawn:
- /setspawn
- /spawn

Supports:
- world, x/y/z, yaw & pitch
- configurable join teleport
- broadcast on spawn change

**🔹 Inventory Tools (InvSee, EnderChests, Offline Support)**

Inspect or edit player inventories:
- /invsee <player>

Special features:
- offline read-only fallback
- editable online inventories
- detailed error messages
- logging & safety prompts

**Multi-EnderChest Support:**
With configurable IDs per player, permissions, and custom slot counts.

```
enderchest:
  max_ids: 5
  slots_per_id:
    "1": 27
    "2": 27
    "3": 36
```

Commands:
- /enderchest <id>

**🔹 Auto-Broadcast System**
- Automatic broadcasts with:
- sequential or random mode
- sounds (optional)
- customizable pitch/volume
- placeholder support such as {online}, {max_players}, {hour}, {day}, etc.

**🔹 Advanced Moderation Suite (Kick, Ban, Mute, Logs, Banlist)**

Staff moderation tools with full formatting and placeholders:

Commands:
- /kick <player> [reason]
- /ban <player> <duration> [reason]
- /mute <player> <duration> [reason]
- /unban <player>
- /unmute <player>
- /banlist
- /banlog <player>
- /banlog <player> clear

Features:
- duration parsing (10s, 5m, 2h, 1d)
- custom ban screen
- mute expiration system
- moderation history logs
- ban & mute listings
- optional broadcast toggle

**🔹 User Info Command (Complete Player Inspector)**

See detailed player information:
- UUID
- IP address
- host name
- ping
- health
- saturation
- dimension
- world & coordinates
- server
- XP level
- first join date
- last seen date

Includes clickable actions:
- banlog
- inventory view
- teleport

**🔹 Repair System (Hand, Inventory, All Items)**

Admins can repair:
- hand items
- entire inventory
- another player’s items

With detailed messages and repairable-item detection.

Commands:
- /repair
- /repair all
- /repair inventory
- /repair [player]

**🔹 Simple Utility Commands (Workbench, Anvil, Enchanting Table & More)**

Open common workbenches anywhere:
- /workbench
- /anvil
- /furnace
- /enchant
- /brew
- /smith
- /loom
- /stonecutter
- /cartography
- /enderchest
- and more…

All with GUI titles & permission checks.

**🔹 PlaceholderAPI Support**

Use placeholders anywhere on your server:
- TAB
- Scoreboards
- Chat
- Holograms
- Bossbars
- Other plugins

**Placeholders:**

- %simpleessentials% - Displays the Version of the installed Plugin.
- %simpleessentials_enderchest_list% - Displays a list of all available custom Enderchest IDs.
- %simpleessentials_enderchest_max% - Displays the maximum amount of custom Enderchests available.
- %simpleessentials_vanish% - Displays either if the player is vanished or not.
- %simpleessentials_homes_count% - Display the amount of homes the player has set.
- %simpleessentials_warps_count% - Displays the amount of set warps on the server.
- %simpleessentials_ping% - Displays the players current ping.
- %simpleessentials_banlog_count% - Displays the amount of entires the player has in his banlog.
- %simpleessentials_deathlog_count% - Display the amount of Deaths stored in the Deathlog for the player.

## 📦 Requirements

- Spigot / Paper 1.16+
- Java 17+
- PlaceholderAPI (optional, for placeholders)
